title: Russian Minecraft Kid Screaming
blurb: Pure unfiltered rage, delivered at a volume no child that size should be able to produce, almost certainly in response to a griefed base. The clip is a small masterpiece of misplaced intensity: the stakes are a house made of blocks and the reaction is total. That mismatch is why it has survived years of reposting. Play it for rage-quit moments, for anyone taking a casual game far too seriously, or as a general warning about what happens when you go through somebody else's chests without asking.
origin: A viral clip of a young Minecraft player screaming.
